prompts.L1:
Edit this photo. Keep everything exactly as it is — the two large shrubs in the middle, the cut-off shrub at the right edge, the soil, the trees, the sky, the light, the colours and the framing. Only add one more rhododendron shrub on the left side of the field, standing on the same dark peat soil in the same light, of exactly the same variety as the others (the same lilac-violet flowers, dark glossy leaves, dense dome shape, foliage down to the ground), whole inside the frame, not touching the left edge, with a natural shadow and soil contact so it looks photographed, not pasted.
The new shrub is as large as the left main shrub and stands in the same front row, to its left, with a gap of soil between them (replace the small shrub that is there now if needed).
